'''2002 Dagobah Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional tournament for the Dagobah region, scheduled for 29 June 2002 at The Deep Comics in Huntsville, Alabama. [[Jim Colson]]'s announcement moved it from Birmingham, Alabama, where no location had been found, to Huntsville, with free entry and a noon start.<ref name="tfn-dag02">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Dagobah_Regional_Scheduled_for_Huntsville_Alabama_66269.asp Dagobah Regional Scheduled for Huntsville, Alabama], TheForce.Net CCG (Jim Colson, posted by Josh, 12 June 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027130201/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Dagobah_Regional_Scheduled_for_Huntsville_Alabama_66269.asp Internet Archive]</ref>
